an10.51.highlight: checking is very helpful for a mendicant’s skillful qualities.
an10.51.question: Look back at today as if in a clear mirror: which of these qualities did you see in yourself, and which did you not?

mn19.highlight: Whatever a mendicant frequently thinks about and considers becomes their heart’s inclination.
mn19.question: Which were the sensual, malicious and cruel thoughts you had? Which were the thoughts of renunciation, good will and harmlessness?

mn20.highlight: That mendicant should focus on some other subject connected with the skillful.
mn20.question: What skillful thought could you have used like a finer peg, to knock out the larger peg of an unskillful thought that arose?

an5.162.highlight: focus on their pure behavior by way of speech.
an5.162.question: Is there someone you felt resentment towards today? What is one good part of them you could pick out, like the usable cloth in the rag?

mn54.highlight: sensual pleasures give little gratification and much suffering and distress
mn54.question: What pleasure from seeing, hearing, tasting, smelling and touching did you reach for today? Did it really ease the hunger, or leave you gnawing for more?

an10.61.highlight: When the seven awakening factors are fulfilled, they fulfill knowledge and freedom.
an10.61.question: What filled you up today? Was it faith, rational application of mind, mindfulness, sense restraint, good conduct, or something else?

an10.44.highlight: I will speak lovingly, not from secret hate.
an10.44.question: Think of something you said today. Was it timely, true, gentle, beneficial and loving? Which of the five was hardest to keep to?

an4.14.highlight: they don’t get caught up in the features and details.
an4.14.question: When you saw, heard, smelled, tasted, touched or thought of something today, where did you get caught up in its features and details?

mn21.highlight: We will remain full of sympathy, with a heart of love and no secret hate.
mn21.question: Was there someone today you felt ill will towards? Did they treat you as badly as bandits sawing off your limbs? What would it take to keep a heart of love for them, even then?

an4.18.highlight: Making decisions unprejudiced by favoritism, hostility, stupidity, and cowardice.
an4.18.question:
What decisions did you make out of favouritism, dislike, confusion or fear, today so far? 
How did that pan out for you?

mn61.highlight: After you have acted with the body, you should check on that same act
mn61.question: Choose one thing you did today. Looking back, did it hurt you, someone else, or both, or did it lead to happiness? What will you take from it?

sn46.55.highlight: you don’t truly know or see what is good for yourself, good for another, or good for both.
sn46.55.question: When was a moment today when desire clouded the water, so you couldn't see what was good for you or for others? What was it like once it settled?

sn47.6.highlight: don’t roam out of your own territory into the domain of others.
sn47.6.question: Where did you wander out of your own territory today? What brought you back?

sn56.11.highlight: peace, direct knowledge, awakening, and extinguishment
sn56.11.question: Where did you lean towards an extreme today, indulging yourself or being too hard on yourself? What would the middle way have looked like?

mn139.highlight: sensual pleasure—a filthy, common, ignoble pleasure.
mn139.question: What sensual pleasure did you go after today? Was there a quieter, inner pleasure you could have turned to instead?

sn22.59.highlight: For if form were self, it wouldn’t lead to affliction
sn22.59.question: What part of your body or mind did you wish were different today? Could you make it so?

an10.2.highlight: It’s only natural for the mind to be immersed in samādhi when you feel bliss.
an10.2.question:
When did your mind settle today without being forced? 
What gladness or ease came before it?

mn128.highlight: I consistently treat these venerables with kindness by way of body, speech, and mind
mn128.question:
Who did you spend the day alongside? 
Where could you have set aside your own ideas and gone along with theirs?

sn22.79.highlight: Choices produce conditioned phenomena; that’s why they’re called ‘choices’.
sn22.79.question: What did you keep choosing to dwell on today? How did that shape what you felt and saw?

mn41.highlight: May these sentient beings live free of enmity and ill will, untroubled and happy!
mn41.question: Did you want something of someone else's today, or wish anyone ill? What kind intentions did you have?

sn45.8.highlight: rapture and bliss born of seclusion
sn45.8.question: Was there a moment today, however brief, when your mind was secluded from sensual pleasures and unskillful thoughts? What was it like?

an3.100.highlight: Suppose a person was to drop a lump of salt into the Ganges River
an3.100.question: Think of a small wrong you did today. Was your heart more like the cup of water or the Ganges? What would make it wider?

mn9.highlight: suffering, its origin, its cessation, and the practice that leads to its cessation.
mn9.question: Where did you meet suffering today? Could you see where it came from, and what would bring it to an end?

sn45.2.highlight: Good friends, companions, and associates are the whole of the spiritual life.
sn45.2.question: Who were your good friends today? How did their company, or its absence, shape your practice?

an10.76.highlight: a fault-finding mind you can’t give up unmindfulness, lack of situational awareness,
an10.76.question: When did you find fault with someone today? What did that do to your mindfulness?

an8.53.highlight: to contentment, not lack of contentment;
an8.53.question: What did you do today that led to contentment, fewer desires or seclusion? What led the other way?

dn16.highlight: they honor, respect, revere, venerate, and esteem the Realized One with the highest honor.
dn16.question: Where did you live in line with the teaching today, and where did you fall short of it?

mn10.highlight: understands mind with greed as ‘mind with greed,’
mn10.question: When did you notice your body today? Could you look at it plainly, part by part, like grains poured out of a bag?

mn135.highlight: owners of their deeds and heir to their deeds. Deeds are their womb, their relative, and their refuge.
mn135.question: What did you do today that you will inherit? Which of today's deeds would you most like to be heir to?

sn12.67.highlight: If the first of those sheaves of reeds were to be pulled away, the other would collapse.
sn12.67.question: Think of a moment of suffering today. What was it leaning on, like one sheaf of reeds on another? What would have happened if that had been pulled away?

an4.13.question: Which of the four efforts did you make today: preventing, giving up, arousing or keeping? Which did you neglect?

dhp100-115.question: Of everything you heard or read today, which single saying brought you peace?

dhp44-59.highlight: the fragrance of virtue is supreme.
dhp44-59.question: Whose virtue did you notice today, your own or someone else's? How did it reach you?

dn29.highlight: The ascetics who follow the Sakyan live indulging in pleasure in these four ways
dn29.question: What pleasure did you indulge in today? Did it lead towards peace, or away from it?

mn48.highlight: If he puts his hand or foot on a burning coal, he quickly pulls it back
mn48.question: Did you do something wrong today? How quickly did you pull back, like a hand from a hot coal, and did you tell anyone?

mn5.highlight: they will focus on the feature of beauty, and because of that, lust will infect their mind.
mn5.question: Where did you dwell on the beauty of something today? What did that stir up in your mind?

mn75.highlight: sensual pleasures are actually painful to touch, they have a distorted perception that they are pleasant
mn75.question: What sensual pleasure did you scratch at today? Looking back, was it truly pleasant, or did it only seem so?

mn81.highlight: He takes what has crumbled off by a riverbank or been dug up by mice, and brings it back in a carrier.

mn82.highlight: The world is wanting, insatiable, the slave of craving
mn82.question: Which of the four summaries rang true for you today: that the world is unstable, without shelter, without an owner, or never satisfied?

sn22.56.highlight: The practice that leads to the cessation of perceptions is simply this noble eightfold path
sn22.56.question: What perception set you off today? What contact did it arise from?

sn22.95.highlight: And it appears to them completely vacuous, hollow, and insubstantial
sn22.95.question: What feeling seemed solid and important today? Looking at it now, how much substance did it really have?

sn35.146.highlight: When you experience freedom due to the cessation of deeds by body, speech, and mind.
sn35.146.question: What new deeds did you do today by body, speech and mind? Which would you rather not repeat?
